Two separate implementations stand between those two texts. The analyzer masks
the excerpt it stores (analyzer_ng/ml/drain.py MASKING_RULES). The modal masks
BOTH the stored quote and the real log line before comparing them
(analyzerSuggestionMeta.js normalizeLine). Neither knows about the other, and
nothing used to fail if they drifted apart.

A change to either implementation breaks its own side's test. Keep the two

cases.why: a plain number, the ordinary case
a signed number: the analyzer eats the sign, the modal does not
a dotted version: the analyzer leaves it, the modal splits it
digits glued to a word: the analyzer leaves them, the modal masks them

a timeout message, the shape the live stand actually carries
